evidence_quotes.quid_pro_quo: Rep skipped the framing entirely. After brief greeting and verifying move date, jumped straight to 'do you have any, just off the top questions or concerns that I can kind of address?' then immediately into probing without the time-boxed ask and promise-of-dependable-quote setup.
evidence_quotes.their_agenda: Not asked. Rep moved directly from initial concern check ('do you have any... questions or concerns') into logistics probing without asking 'Other than price, what are your biggest concerns about this move?'
evidence_quotes.discovery_basics: All four present: name (Zachary), moving day (October 7th), route (11307 Bell Belich Drive San Antonio to 946 Riverstone Drive San Antonio), approximate size (1500 sq ft source, 2600 sq ft destination).
evidence_quotes.logistics_details_gathered: Comprehensive: property type (house), floors (two stories at both locations), rooms/items (dining table, chairs, bench, sectional, couches, queen bed, recliner, desk, 2-3 bookshelves, gun safe, TV, 55 boxes), walking distance/access (driveway <20 feet, can pull truck on driveway or street), special considerations (150 lb gun safe, empty).
evidence_quotes.box_count_asked: Yes: 'so, what is the access looks like... I do have approximately 55 boxes, is that correct as well?'
evidence_quotes.estimate_anchor: Full. Hourly rate ($192/hr for two movers), inclusions (disassemble/reassemble, wrapping, padding, drive time, taxes, insurance), time range (3–4 hours likely, up to 5 hours as reservation buffer), 2.5-hour minimum, budget estimate ($678–$960).
evidence_quotes.pricing_framing: Full. Disclosed: hourly rate, two-mover crew, all inclusions (disassembly, wrapping, padding, drive time, taxes, insurance), no hidden fees, minimum 2.5 hours, pay-for-time-used, free to reserve and cancel, free to modify.
evidence_quotes.feels_fair_then_silence: Not asked. Customer said 'Yeah, no that price sounds great to me. So let's go ahead and reserve it then for next Sunday.' Rep immediately responded 'Okay, you got it' without asking 'Does that feel fair?' or holding silence.
evidence_quotes.on_time_guarantee_delivered: Full. Rep stated: 'if for whatever reason we don't arrive in that timeslot window then money will be deducted off for your final bill.'
evidence_quotes.damage_coverage_delivered: Partial. Rep mentioned 'no worries, damage coverage as well which does cover-up. To $2,000 for kind of any kind of incidentals' but did not clarify no-deductible, no-fine-print framing, or that it's built into the rate, not an add-on.
evidence_quotes.closes_the_loop: No. Rep delivered both promises but never asked 'Does that put those to rest?' or similar confirmation that the two promises addressed the customer's concerns (which were never explicitly raised anyway).
evidence_quotes.final_concerns_check: Not asked. After confirming the estimate and booking, rep asked 'did you have any other questions for me' (throwaway/empty) but never asked 'What's still concerning you about this move?'
evidence_quotes.catch_all_asked: No. Rep did not ask 'Anything coming with you we haven't talked about?' or equivalent.
evidence_quotes.explicit_ask: Never asked. Customer volunteered 'So let's go ahead and reserve it then for next Sunday,' but rep never asked 'Would you like our help with your move?' — the customer self-closed.
evidence_quotes.booking_confirmed: Partial. Rep confirmed: date (next Sunday, October 7th), arrival window (8:00–8:30 AM), email sent with $960 estimate. Missing: phone number, crew size (mentioned two movers in estimate but not confirmed at booking), crew notes about customer's concerns (no concerns were raised, so nothing to note, but the slot is missing).

top_strength: Comprehensive and methodical logistics probing—the rep gathered all seven detail categories (property type, floors, rooms, access, special considerations, items, box count) with clear follow-ups and captured a complete move picture.
coaching_note: Never asked 'Other than price, what are your biggest concerns?' (Their Agenda) or the quid-pro-quo framing at the open—you jumped straight into probing, missing the opportunity to uncover what mattered most to this customer before pitching price and promises.
